# @three-ws/notifications-mcp

> Read and manage your three.ws notification inbox from any AI agent — list inbound events (pump/market alerts, sales, purchases, social, IRL, account), mark read, tune the per-category delivery matrix, and register Web Push devices. Account-scoped over the live API via a Bearer API key.

@three-ws/notifications-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/notifications-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/push-notifications-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/push-notifications-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/push-notifications-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/push-notifications-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
